purpose: Matched static-supervision versus nuisance-balanced supervision repair diagnostic; no automatic P0 authorization.
precision: unchanged BF16 CUDA autocast; model output cast FP32 before spatial pooling; pooled values cast BF16 then promoted to FP32 storage

data.seed_scheme: first 8 bytes little-endian of SHA256(v5.3-nuisance-repair-1/role/block), NumPy default_rng

anchor.release: after complete FIT model/source/plan freeze and verified GitHub publication

bridge.release: after complete FIT freeze/publication and attested no previous access

nuisance.positions: a,b independently uniform on [0.1,0.9); renderer uses integer pixel centers int(x*224)
nuisance.sampling_order: center, displacement magnitude, displacement sign, object colors, nuisance positions a and b
nuisance.coincident_pixels: retain and report, never reject or reseed

data.targets: end positions and observed end-start displacement; identical for all four nuisance paths of each target view
data.negative_control_targets: center position C with all four displacements zero; evaluation only, never fitted

reader.selection: none; no CV, kernel/alpha grid, seed selection or checkpoint selection

S.name: static-supervision with shared unlabeled FIT normalization

B.name: balanced-supervision with the same shared normalization

reader.world_loss_weight: each of 256 FIT worlds has total empirical loss weight 1/256 in either arm; views uniform within each arm/world
reader.normalization_reference: all 4096 B views from the same 256 FIT worlds, separately for each input reader; no evaluation input or label
reader.kernel_definition: center and trace-normalize linear kernel using full B reference; square (1+k); center and trace-normalize quadratic RKHS kernel using the same full B reference
reader.query_normalization: both centering passes use all B-reference columns, then select S or B prediction basis columns
reader.intercept: both arms fit an unpenalized intercept in the same shared kernel geometry; shared FIT target mean remains the score baseline, not a forced prediction intercept
reader.solve: FP64 augmented solve [[K_arm+n_arm*mean_loss_alpha*I,1],[1^T,0]] [coefficients;intercept]=[y_arm;0], or algebraically equivalent Schur complement; never recenter the shared kernel
reader.single_frame_arm_equivalence: weighted input-label empirical distributions are identical between S and B for t6 and t7; require maximum absolute S/B prediction difference <=1e-7 on shared FIT and every evaluation set; freeze tolerance using software fixtures before scientific data, never relax after observing FIT/evaluation
freeze: six arm/input coefficient arrays and fitted unpenalized intercepts
shared two-level normalization moments per input
complete FIT feature basis and row indices
FIT cache and model SHA256 receipts

primary_endpoint.population: fresh original-generator bridge, dev paired worlds 384..639
primary_endpoint.loss: pair-average squared error over both variants and A_dx/B_dx, in normalized image-coordinate squared units

bootstrap.unit: complete paired world retaining both variants, both arms and every coordinate

primary_endpoint.positive_primary_evidence: 95% lower endpoint >0; describe as relative dx-error improvement only

bridge: all eight per-coordinate MSE and common-FIT-mean skill
motion direction error with zero/tie counts
paired S-B effects for t6 and t7
anchor: per-path, static-average and moving-average absolute motion skills
per-path end-anchor (view0-view1)/2 and start-anchor (view2-view3)/2 against nonzero d
all eight per-coordinate contrast skills for both arms
negative_control: per-axis predicted motion RMS: square each path prediction before averaging over both directions/worlds, never average opposite signed predictions first
RMS divided by corresponding nonzero FIT displacement RMS
supporting_metrics.uncertainty: complete-block/pair bootstrap with seed7811 and 10000 replicates for S-B bridge dx/Motion-NMSE differences, anchor motion/contrast skills and negative-control RMS comparisons; secondary intervals descriptive and unadjusted; direction/amplitude/bias/covariance are point diagnostics without separate significance claims
supporting_metrics.anti_collapse_interpretation: a positive primary alone is insufficient for a motion-preserving repair claim; if B fresh-bridge mean motion skill is nonpositive, describe relative improvement with unresolved transfer, not repair; examine all B coordinate skills, nonzero per-path anchor contrasts, direction/amplitude and negative-control RMS together; no output correction or after-the-fact new gate

release_order: freeze and publish code/plan/protocol plus no-access audit
freeze and publish both arms/all readers
fresh anchor extraction and CPU evaluation
fresh bridge extraction and CPU evaluation
execution.scientific_metric_stop: none within this locked diagnostic; report anchor and bridge regardless of favorable metric signs if execution remains valid
execution.budget_rule: reserve startup/shutdown and all failed attempts; inherit exact prior ledger; version cap and retained54GPUh both enforced; CPU fit/eval no GPU step
execution.failed_scene_policy: retain on execution/archive failure, old gate failure, or an unresolved scientific repair; no automatic cleanup

freshness.scope_limit: known local artifacts/source/tests plus executor-reviewed remote records; not a claim about unknown external experiments
freshness.executor_required: write inspected path/hash evidence and attest no fresh FIT/anchor/bridge access before release; any newly discovered prior access stops this registration
